entities.summary: Schwarzenberg Castle is a castle and museum in Germany. It was based on a medieval fortification and together with St. George's Church dominates the scene of the large county town of Schwarzenberg in Saxony's district of Erzgebirgskreis. Schwarzenberg Castle is a château from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
